note: Dimensions a rule may look at. The vocabulary is open: a rule may name a dimension that is not listed here, provided the name does not begin with aaf. No list has to use any of them.

dimensions.name: aaf.designation
dimensions.covers: The manager's own choice to admit or refuse an object
questions: Who holds the authority to maintain the list
Which object the entry points at
dimensions.distinguish: A choice not to work with an object asserts nothing about the object

dimensions.name: aaf.identity
dimensions.covers: Accounts, registered agent identities, address-anchored identities, who controls an identity, delegation
questions: May the caller act for it
dimensions.distinguish: That an identity exists and that the caller may act for it are checked separately

dimensions.name: aaf.credential
dimensions.covers: Profiles, know-your-agent assertions, qualifications, capability or credit assessments
dimensions.distinguish: An assertion is a statement by its issuer, not a fact established by the list

dimensions.name: aaf.principal
dimensions.covers: Verification of the person or organisation behind an agent, and of payment instruments
questions: Which person or organisation was verified
How it is bound to the agent
dimensions.distinguish: Source documents and numbers stay off chain; a rule asks for the result, its issuer, its validity and its binding to the subject

dimensions.name: aaf.runtime
dimensions.covers: Runtime history, instances, code digests, harness, tool permissions, configuration versions
dimensions.distinguish: An environment used in the past and the environment of this request are different propositions

dimensions.name: aaf.inference
dimensions.covers: Models and inference services used, metered usage, inference entitlements redeemed, properties of inputs and outputs
questions: Which calls and how much usage
dimensions.distinguish: Holding an entitlement, having made calls, and this request being served by a given model are three propositions with three kinds of evidence

dimensions.name: aaf.performance
dimensions.covers: Tasks completed, acceptance records, quality, timeliness, repeated failure
dimensions.distinguish: A history belongs to whoever performed it, which need not be the current controller of an identity

dimensions.name: aaf.relation
dimensions.covers: Counterparties, collaborators, group membership, delegation of business
questions: Does a result pass along it
dimensions.distinguish: A relation is information; whether a result follows it is decided by the rule, never assumed

dimensions.name: aaf.activity
dimensions.covers: On-chain transactions, settlement, stake, proof of assets, default or repayment records
dimensions.distinguish: The absence of a record is a claim about a named source and window, not about the world

dimensions.name: aaf.safety
dimensions.covers: Adoption of safety specifications, incidents, suspension
dimensions.distinguish: An incident report and an established incident are different

dimensions.name: aaf.dispute
dimensions.covers: Disputes involving the object and their outcomes
dimensions.distinguish: Allegation, investigation, interim measure and final finding are labelled as such

dimensions.name: aaf.reputation
dimensions.covers: Feedback signals and aggregates of them
dimensions.distinguish: An aggregate is the output of a method that has to be named

dimensions.name: aaf.liveness
dimensions.covers: Whether the object is alive and reachable, unfinished work, concurrency in use, available quota
questions: How stale may the reading be
Is it checked again before execution
dimensions.distinguish: Seeing capacity is not reserving it

dimensions.name: aaf.list
questions: What if it cannot be read
dimensions.distinguish: A list that cannot be read yields an undetermined result, never a skipped one
